message.content: {"claims":[{"quote":"67% of freight clerks miss the last sailing on Pier 4 to Gull Island."},{"quote":"41% of day visitors miss the last sailing on Pier 4 to Gull Island."},{"quote":"Queue time at the Old Quay to Heron Point kiosk rose 24% after the timetable change."},{"quote":"11% of commuters miss the last sailing on Pier 4 to Gull Island."},{"quote":"Refund requests are down 48%, so the new policy is working."},{"quote":"52% of school parties miss the last sailing on Northgate to Saltmarsh."},{"quote":"The Old Quay to Heron Point service carried 5800 passengers last month."},{"quote":"Queue time at the Northgate to Saltmarsh kiosk rose 20% after the timetable change."},{"quote":"The segment we are building for is island residents who cross more than twice a week."},{"quote":"Our target customers are adults aged 36 to 64 who travel by ferry."}],"needs":[{"quote":"School parties need to board the Old Quay to Heron Point ferry without queueing at the kiosk."},{"quote":"School parties need a QR ticket wallet."},{"quote":"School parties need a QR ticket wallet."},{"quote":"Island residents need a live-map screen."},{"quote":"School parties want to know whether the Pier 4 to Gull Island sailing is delayed before leaving home."},{"quote":"School parties need to change a ticket without calling anyone."},{"quote":"School parties want a refund within a day of cancelling."},{"quote":"Freight clerks want a refund within a day of cancelling."},{"quote":"Day visitors want a refund within a day of cancelling."}],"stories":[{"quote":"As a day visitors traveller, I want to buy a return ticket for Northgate to Saltmarsh so that I can plan one trip."}],"dependencies":[]}
